slides.title: Welcome to Subtrak
slides.body: Keep recurring subscriptions and one-time purchases together, so you always know where your money goes.

slides.title: Add what you pay for
slides.body: Enter the amount, billing cycle, category, and start date. Subtrak handles recurring and one-time payments.

slides.title: Understand your spending
slides.body: See monthly and yearly costs, upcoming billing dates, spending history, and category breakdowns on your dashboard.

slides.title: Stay ahead of renewals
slides.body: Turn on email reminders for recurring payments. You can adjust reminders, currency, language, timezone, and appearance in Settings.
